title: Pipeline Overview

narrative_arc.enters_knowing: They want to understand the full system topology before deploying or integrating.
narrative_arc.leaves_knowing: Every component, its role, its connection to adjacent components, and which are automated vs. manual.
steps: Master Mermaid diagram — all services, all data flows, CKAN automation dashes vs. manual arrows
Component table — service name, image, role, public URL or 'internal only'
Two transformation paths — direct YARRRML/RML vs. two-stage YARRRML + SPARQL CONSTRUCT
Automation boundary — what CKAN automates, what requires manual trigger

inline_assets_required.description: Master system diagram: all Docker services, data flow arrows, CKAN automation lanes. Dashed arrows = automated, solid = manual or data flow.
Component table: 12 rows, columns: Service | Docker image | Role | Public URL | Managed by

quality_gate: Mermaid diagram present showing all 12 services from datastack.json
Component table has Docker image name for each service
Automation boundary explicitly called out (what CKAN automates vs. manual)
notes: Fetch real /info responses from public services to get accurate version numbers for component table.

primary.name: Operator
knows: Basic networking: ports, URLs, reverse proxies
Reading and editing YAML and JSON
does_not_know: What a triple store is or why it exists
primary.goal: Get the stack deployed, configured, and running reliably.
primary.key_gap: Strong on infrastructure, zero on semantics. Semantic explanations should be deferred or skipped — ops context only.

secondary.name: Data Engineer
secondary.goal: Connect data sources, author mappings, and query transformation results.

secondary.name: Domain Scientist
secondary.goal: Upload their data, trigger the pipeline, and use or export FAIR-compliant results.
